title: Start tasks from the UI, with an optional coding agent
summary: Add a one-click Start action on tasks and an optional 'Start with agent' action that runs a sandboxed Claude Code coding agent on a task branch.
rationale: Product owner asked to start tasks from the UI and chose both a Start button and an optional agent launch. The coding agent needs its own security requirement because, unlike the chat agent (REQ-0041), it edits code and runs commands. The dependency-check question was not answered, so no dependency rule is included (tasks have no dependency field today).

data.title: Start task action
data.statement: The system shall offer a Start action on every todo task in the tasks list and the record drawer that moves the task to in-progress in 1 click.
data.rationale: Starting work today means opening the drawer and editing the status field.

acceptance_criteria.text: Start is shown only on tasks with status todo, in the list row and in the record drawer
1 click sets the task to in-progress as a single commit
In the same commit, the task's story and that story's epic move from todo to in-progress; parents that are blocked or done are left unchanged
If the task changed since it was loaded, Start returns 409, the status is unchanged and the row refreshes

data.title: Start task with coding agent
data.statement: The system shall, after user confirmation, launch a Claude Code coding agent for a task in its story's component repository on a dedicated branch, briefed with the task, story, requirements and acceptance criteria, and stream its progress to the UI.
data.rationale: Lets a product owner hand a planned task straight to an agent while keeping the work traceable to requirements.

acceptance_criteria.text: A confirmation dialog shows the component path, the branch name reqforge/TASK-NNNN and the full brief; nothing runs until the user confirms
The agent runs via the local claude CLI in a git worktree of the component on branch reqforge/TASK-NNNN
The brief contains the task description and done_when, the story narrative, each linked requirement statement and acceptance criteria, and the trace tag convention
Agent progress streams to the task drawer and the user can cancel the run
When the run ends, the task shows its branch, commits and exit status, and the task status is never set to done automatically
Start with agent is disabled, with the reason shown, when the story has no component or the component has no path

data.title: Coding agent sandbox
data.statement: The system shall confine a task's coding agent to its own worktree and task branch so that 0 commits reach the default branch and 0 files outside that worktree change without human review.
data.rationale: Unlike the chat agent (REQ-0041), the coding agent edits code and runs commands, so its blast radius must be bounded and its runs auditable.

acceptance_criteria.text: An agent run makes 0 commits or pushes to the default branch and pushes only to reqforge/TASK-* branches
An agent run writes 0 files outside its worktree, including the requirements repository
The coding agent has 0 reqforge record-write or changeset-apply tools
Every run is logged with task id, starting user, start and end time, branch and exit status

standards: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 LLM06 Excessive Agency

stories: New EPIC-0010 with STORY-0011 (Start button, web, 3 pts) and STORY-0012 (coding agent, server, 8 pts)
code: server: new start route next to the existing record routes; the agent launcher can reuse the claude -p invocation in server/src/chat.rs (REQ-0015/REQ-0047), but with a separate coding tool policy
web: Start button on task rows and in web/src/components/RecordDrawer.tsx; new agent dialog and run view
New tests: server/tests/agent_run.rs, server/tests/agent_sandbox.rs, web/e2e/suites/task-start.js and agent-start.js (none exist yet)
evals: STORY-0012/E1 integration, E2 e2e and E3 security cover REQ-0050 and REQ-0051 (all 10 ACs)
risks: The coding agent edits code and runs commands. REQ-0051 must be implemented and passing before 'Start with agent' is enabled
No dependency check between tasks: tasks have no depends-on field today, and that question was left unanswered
Component records need a path for 'Start with agent' to be usable (REQ-0050 AC6)
